 Vidarbha vs Mumbai SMAT Live Streaming: Watch Suryakumar Yadav In Blazing Form
 Sportsdunia Desk Published -  Nov 20, 2026, 10:12 AM 2 min comment Add on As Preferred Source Syed Mushtaq Ali Trophy Suryakumar Yadav The 2026-27 edition of the Syed Mushtaq Ali Trophy hosts another blockbuster clash on November 20, as Mumbai will take on Vidarbha at one of the biggest cricket stadiums in India , Eden Gardens. The match will begin at 4:30 PM IST as both teams enter the fixture without a single defeat in the tournament yet.
 The match is in the spotlight due to captain Suryakumar Yadav's phenomenal batting performances in the previous matchups against Hyderabad, Gujarat and Goa. Vidarbha have also come out as one of the teams to watch out for in the group under Atharva Taide 's leadership. 
 With consecutive match-defining knocks by one of the best T20 batsmen of all time , Suryakumar Yadav, this clash is particularly intriguing as Vidarbha's bowling attack prepares for the destructive Mumbai batter. Fans who are looking to watch the Vidarbha vs Mumbai SMAT 2026 Live Streaming can find platforms providing the same here in this article.
 Where to Watch Vidarbha vs Mumbai SMAT 2026 Live? 
 The Vidarbha vs Mumbai Syed Mushtaq Ali Trophy live stream is not available; hence, the fans will have no access to watch the game live. For India's premium domestic T20 tournament, the BCCI has only listed a few select matches to be streamed live and televised on channels.
 Latest updates on the streaming platforms and Vidarbha vs Mumbai SMAT live telecast channels will be available on the Sportsdunia live cricket score . It will provide you the fastest updates related to this match.

 Suryakumar Yadav Sets SMAT Ablaze
 Mumbai captain Suryakumar Yadav has been in sensational form with the bat in the SMAT 2026-27 season, amassing 167 runs in three innings at a strike rate of 269.35. Mumbai began their campaign with a seven-wicket win against Hyderabad, where Surya scored an unbeaten 60 off 21 balls.
 Suryakumar registered another match-winning knock against Gujarat, producing an explosive 82 off just 29 balls. This innings was particularly destructive as he struck nine fours and seven sixes, with a half-century in just 18 balls.
 Suryakumar Yadav now enters the battle against Vidarbha as Mumbai's biggest batting threat and one of the players who are most in form this tournament. Mumbai squad also features other exciting key players like Shivam Dube , Sarfaraz Khan, Shardul Thakur and Tushar Deshpande.
